integrity: Proof is self-contained; finite checker is a diagnostic, not a proof or external certification. Scientific originality is a qualified literature comparison and is not a claim of absolute historical uniqueness.
scientific_limitations: Fully specified continuous null only; independent uniformized observations; unique minimizer is not given as an elementary expression; results do not cover fitted parameters, alternatives, conditional test size or general joint-distribution recovery. Classical hidden joint-moment coverage remains possible.
title: Convex Anderson–Darling response to the sample maximum, despite negative covariance
